main_dirt.surface: Dirt (Silt, clay, and sandy loam cushion)
main_dirt.bias_notes: Counter-clockwise (left-handed). World-famous 1-mile dirt oval featuring a long 1,234-foot home straight. The Louisville dirt surface is unique — it can play cuppy and tiring on hot dry days, or become a fast 'highway' rail bias when sealed after rain. The 1,234ft stretch gives deep swoopers ('S' and 'C' styles) ample time to run down early leaders in route races.
main_dirt.post_bias: ONE-TURN CHUTE VS TWO-TURN ROUTES: In 7f and 1 Mile 1-turn chute races, outer post draws have a long run to settle before the turn. In 2-turn routes (1 1/16M, 1 1/8M, 1 1/4M Kentucky Derby), saving ground on the inside rails (draws 1-6) is crucial to avoid running wide around both turns.

secretariat_turf.surface: Turf (Rebuilt Tahoma 31 Bermuda grass with sub-surface drainage)
secretariat_turf.bias_notes: Counter-clockwise (left-handed). Completely rebuilt $10M+ state-of-the-art turf course located inside the main dirt track. Features tighter turns than the dirt track. Rail positions (0ft, 12ft, 24ft, 30ft out) heavily dictate bias — when rails are out, inside front-runners ('E') and box-seaters ('P') hold a dominant ground-saving advantage.
secretariat_turf.post_bias: INSIDE DRAW ADVANTAGE IN TURF ROUTES: Inside barriers (1-5) are advantageous in 1 Mile and 1 1/16 Mile turf routes due to the short 200m run to the first tight turn.

handicapping_angles.kentucky_derby_and_spring_autumn_class: Home of the Kentucky Derby ($5M G1 - 1 1/4M), Kentucky Oaks ($1.5M G1 - 1 1/8M), Stephen Foster ($1M G1), Clark Handicap ($1M G1), and Churchill Downs Stakes (G1). Class ratings represent top Tier 1 international grade (+4.0 pts class angle).
handicapping_angles.churchill_dirt_horses_for_courses: Churchill Downs dirt has one of the highest 'Horses for Courses' predictability ratings in North America. Heavily upgrade horses with proven winning form specifically over the Churchill dirt (+3.0 pts), as many horses refuse to handle this unique Louisville clay/silt cushion.
handicapping_angles.1234ft_stretch_stamina_test: In route races (1 1/16M+), front-runners ('E' style) that over-exert early frequently fold over the final 100 yards of the 1,234ft stretch. Upgrade mid-pack stalkers ('P') and closing swoopers ('S' / 'C') with high late 300m sectional speed.
handicapping_angles.gulfstream_and_nyra_shipper_advantage: In spring and autumn undercard stakes/allowances, respect elite shippers arriving from New York (Saratoga, Belmont) or Gulfstream Park, as NYRA/Florida class form carries a strong speed figure advantage over regional midwest horses.
handicapping_angles.rail_position_turf_bias: On the Secretariat Turf Course, monitor rail settings. When the portable rail is set at 24ft or 30ft, outer draws struggle to cross over, creating a heavy inside rail bias.
